# Beyond Nakasendo Cycling

> Guided half-day e-bike tours and self-guided e-bike rentals through the hidden side of the Kiso Valley in Nagiso, Nagano, Japan — near the Nakasendo post towns of Tsumago and Magome. Local guides take you to emerald gorges, old forest-railway paths, river swimming holes, and an onsen, away from the day-tripper crowds. Operated by Kashiwaya Guesthouse (From Scratch LLC).

## Key facts
- Base: Nagiso, Kiso Valley, Nagano, Japan (near Tsumago & Magome on the Nakasendo)
- Bikes: MOVE fat-tire e-bikes; helmet, lock, and lights included
- Schedule: half-day rides, 10:00–16:00
- Start/end points (mix and match): Kashiwaya Guesthouse, Nagiso Station, or Nojiri Station
- Free luggage shuttle between Nagiso Station, Kashiwaya, and Nojiri Station with every booking
- Payment: secure card payment via Square; instant confirmation
- Contact: phone/text +81 90-3839-2354, email ravnicaguild@gmail.com

## Routes
- Tsumago, Revisited — easy; best in spring & autumn; a quiet local road into Tsumago post town
- Natural AC & Onsen — moderate; best in summer (river swim) & early winter (onsen); rice-paddy roads and two waterfalls
- Nakasendo Challenge — hard; the Yogawa trail crossing, for confident riders only

## Pricing
- E-bike rental (self-guided): ¥4,000 for one bike, ¥8,000 for two (up to 2 bikes)
- Guided tour (half day, up to 2 guests): ¥13,000 with one bike, ¥17,000 with two
- Opening campaign: ¥7,000 off a guided tour (¥6,000 / one bike, ¥10,000 / two) in exchange for photo consent and feedback — limited-time launch offer
- Luggage shuttle: free with every booking
